question: Who is referred to as 'Frontier Gandhi'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan is referred to as 'Frontier Gandhi'.
 
• He was a **Pashtun independence activist**, who was also known as** Bacha Khan.**
 
• He was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and was a follower of **non-violent resistance.**
 
• Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan was also the founder of the **Khudai Khidmatgar movement,** which was based on the principles of non-violence and social reform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajendra Prasad **was the **first President **of India.

 
 
• He was also a freedom fighter who played a significant role in **India's struggle for independence.**
 
 
 
• **Ashfaqullah Khan **was a revolutionary who participated in the** Kakori train robbery.**
 
 
• He was subsequently **executed** by the British. 
 
 
 
• **Rajkumar Shukla** was a farmer.
 
 
• He played a crucial role in convincing Mahatma Gandhi to launch the **Champaran Satyagraha in Bihar.**
